title: SHRDLU natural-language system documented by Terry Winograd
summary: Stanford University teaching materials identify Terry Winograd's SHRDLU as a 1972 natural-language system that parsed user input, mapped it to logical form, interpreted that form within a blocks-world environment, took appropriate action, and generated responses.
significance: A documented early natural-language-understanding system milestone.
